profiles.name: experimental

mcp_tasks.note: The setting is reserved; this server does not advertise or execute MCP Tasks.

mcp_apps.note: Optional sandboxed read-only project review UI; data uses existing policy-enforced MCP tools.

mcp_skills.note: Publishes two bundled read-oriented Skills using experimental SDK attachment; default off.

mcp_v2.note: Enables opt-in dual-era HTTP and stdio support for MCP 2026-07-28 while retaining legacy defaults.

ai_provider.note: Provider/model settings are reserved; no in-process AI provider is invoked.

otel_export.note: OTLP settings are reserved; the current observability path is local structured metrics.

remote_relay.note: The paired relay path is implemented behind explicit configuration and is not Beta.

raw_execution.note: Raw execution requires both development-only gates and remains quarantined.

oauth.note: OAuth/JWKS validation is implemented and mandatory for non-loopback HTTP.
